queue.claim: Tear trough ligament runs from about the medial canthus to the mid-pupillary line on the medial infraorbital rim and continues laterally as the orbicularis retaining ligament, which is tight medially and lax laterally. The note uses this for the tear trough and lid-cheek placement priors (medial end 3-6 mm below endocanthion; lateral end 14-18 mm below pupil centre).
queue.query: tear trough ligament Wong Hsieh Mendelson 2012 origin medial canthus midpupillary line orbicularis retaining ligament

queue.claim: The mandibular ligament is either a true osteocutaneous ligament on the anterior third of the mandible about 1 cm above the lower border (Furnas), or it exists only in the sub-platysmal plane (Minelli 2022). The engine places it at jaw arc fraction 0.25 +/- 0.07 from menton.
